message: Irma has proposed a card game for later on this evening, and she wants Lady Brit, Horatio, and Marcellus to attend.
This so-called 'spy' put a dagger in my heart. Surely someone can help me stay alive this time.
Rumors are flying that Elsinore Castle is haunted... by the ghost of the late King Hamlet himself.
I believe time is repeating itself, but I haven't any idea why. I was certain I should have died, but—I woke up in my own bed.
Othello, the barkeep in town, is being extorted by thugs.
Time is repeating itself. What is going on?
Hamlet is acting strangely. He showed up in my room, his hair a mess and his eyes wild. What's going on with him?
My father died by Hamlet's hand.
